question.prompt: For how many integer values of \(x\) is \(|2x| \le 7\pi?\)

solutions.title: Bound and count the integers
solutions.explanation:
Since \(x\) is an integer, \(2x\) must be even. To find the allowed even integers, use \(3<\pi<3.142\), which gives
\[
21<7\pi<7(3.142)=21.994<22.
\]
Thus \(|2x|\) can be at most \(20\): every even integer from \(-20\) through \(20\) works, while the next possible absolute value, \(22\), is too large.

Dividing by \(2\), the possible values of \(x\) are
\[
-10,-9,\ldots,0,\ldots,9,10.
\]
There are \(10+1+10=21\) values. The answer is \(\boxed{21}\), choice \(\text{E}\).
